title: Resulta
summary: How can a total API and explicit errors stay ergonomic across ESM and CJS?
context: A small library for investigating typed results, module interoperability, and documented guarantees.
constraints: No path should return an implicit state.
ESM and CJS must expose the same contract.

decisions.title: Total API
decisions.body: Every operation represents success and error in its return type.

decisions.title: Dual distribution
decisions.body: Both module formats share documented guarantees.

evidence.label: Public package
evidence.detail: API, ESM/CJS builds, and versioned documentation.

limits: The library exposes errors; it does not choose application recovery policies.
Adoption and production use are not claimed.
